name: ls-check
description: Live diagnostics for TP .LS programs (companion to the TP editor extension)

lscheck.debounceMs.description: Delay after typing stops before re-checking.

lscheck.limits.description: Override index limits, e.g. {"pr": 1000, "r": 1000, "vr": 10, "do": 1024, "ro": 8, "gi": 100}. Keys: p, pr, vr, r, di, do, ri, ro, gi, go, ai, ao, ui, uo, si, so, f, m, sr, ar, timer, payload, uframe, utool.

lscheck.macros.description: Macro names accepted without an unknown-instruction hint.

lscheck.externalPrograms.description: Programs that exist only on the controller; CALL/RUN to these is never reported as unknown-program.

lscheck.completions.enabled.description: Offer instruction templates and index/program suggestions on /MN lines.

lscheck.completions.semicolon.description: Write the closing ';' (with the controller's padding) in inserted templates. Off by default so the TP editor extension, which places ';' itself, is not fought; spacing is then corrected by lscheck.autoFixSpacing.

lscheck.autoFixSpacing.description: After you move off a line you just edited, rewrite its bad-spacing problems (pad before ';', gap after the colon, inner gaps) to the controller form. Applied once per line text.
